svg.aria-label: A conductor of length l lies across two parallel rails, at right angles to them, and can slide along the rails with velocity v. The magnetic field B points straight down through the plane containing the rails, at right angles to that plane. The conductor's length, its velocity and the magnetic field are mutually perpendicular to one another, which is why the simple formula e = B x l x v applies.

text.tspan: B, l and v are mutually perpendicular
